summary: HelmCharts 2af8b69 on phase/018-P6: charts/pgadmin gains oidc.issuerUrl; when set it ships config_local.py (Keycloak button beside the internal login, gated on pgadmin_roles containing admin, MASTER_PASSWORD_REQUIRED off for Keycloak sessions), OIDC client id/secret from externalSecrets.secrets.oidc as env, and a keycloak-admin init container that pre-creates the operator's OAuth2 account as admin with servers.json (sharing the local admin's pgpassfile). The prd release turns it on against the homelab realm with eso/prd/pgadmin/prd/oidc; the dev release renders as before. Witnessed end to end on the live pgAdmin 9.18 image against a fake Keycloak in the development namespace; new test green, kc project test green.
